events.name: Bash
events.head: Read patches README; make scratch clone off development
events.input: $ sed -n 1,60p workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/README.md; S=/tmp/t396-scratch; rm -rf $S; git clone -q --no-hardlinks ~/tantra-feedback-work/tantra-backend-v2 $S && cd $S && git checkout -q -b [redacted] origin/development && git log --oneline -1 && ls; grep -rln "contactListIds" src | head -30

events.input: $ cd /tmp/t396-scratch && wc -l src/domains/contacts/campaign-contact-intake.service.ts && sed -n 1,200p src/domains/contacts/campaign-contact-intake.service.ts; grep -rn "CampaignContactIntake\|appendContacts\|append-contacts\|intake" src --include=*.ts -il | head

events.name: Bash

events.input: $ cd /tmp/t396-scratch && sed -n 36,155p src/domains/contacts/campaign-contact-intake.service.ts; grep -rn "CampaignContactIntakeService\|AddCampaignContactsDto" src --include=*.ts | grep -v "^src/domains/contacts/campaign-contact-intake" | head -20; git log --oneline -3 -- src/domains/contacts/campaign-contact-intake.service.ts

events.input: $ cd /tmp/t396-scratch && git show --stat --format='%h %an %ad%n%s%n%b' e571b78 | head -50; git branch -r --contains e571b78 | head; grep -rn "contacts/append\|:id/contacts\|appendContacts\|addContacts" src --include='*.controller.ts' | head
